name: Apex Athletics E-Commerce
tagline: High-conversion WooCommerce store with custom checkout flow & instant search.
problem: Legacy WooCommerce site took 7.2 seconds to load and dropped 65% of mobile cart checkouts due to bloated plugin stack.
solution: Built custom Gutenberg block-based theme, integrated custom Stripe/Razorpay AJAX checkout, optimized image delivery with WebP & Redis caching.
result: 99/100 Mobile Lighthouse performance score, 1.1s load time, and +42% conversion rate increase.

name: SaaS Matrix Tech Portal
tagline: Headless-ready ultra-fast custom theme for global B2B SaaS platform.
problem: Client relied on heavyweight Elementor setup causing DOM bloat, SEO penalties, and slow page rendering.
solution: Architected custom lightweight theme from scratch using Timber/Twig templates, Native ACF blocks, and Tailwind CSS.
result: Reduced DOM node count by 78%, achieved top 3 Google search rankings for 14 primary keywords.

name: FinTech Capital Portal
tagline: Speed optimization & enterprise security hardening for corporate finance portal.
problem: Severe server CPU throttling during peak traffic hours, malware infection vulnerabilities, 8.4s initial load.
solution: Cleaned core files, implemented Cloudflare Enterprise WAF, database query indexing, assets minification, and Object Cache.
result: Zero downtime during 50k simultaneous visitor spike, 800ms average response time.

name: Luxe Estate Real Estate Hub
tagline: Custom real estate IDX property sync plugin & interactive map search.
problem: Existing MLS plugin was crashing server due to unoptimized database queries on 20,000+ property listings.
solution: Engineered custom WordPress plugin with custom SQL tables, REST API endpoints, and Leaflet JS map integration.
result: Property search query time cut from 4.8s to 120ms; handles over 20,000 active listings smoothly.

name: HealthPulse Telehealth Booking
tagline: HIPAA-compliant online doctor consultation booking & WooCommerce subscription platform.
problem: Complex scheduling needs and recurring payment subscriptions couldn't be handled by standard plugins.
solution: Customized WooCommerce Subscriptions, added custom calendar booking engine, Twilio SMS notifications, and Zoom API integration.
result: Automated 92% of patient appointment bookings, generated $120k recurring monthly revenue.

name: Urban Vibe Media Publisher
tagline: High-traffic news magazine optimized for Google Core Web Vitals & Google News inclusion.
problem: Failed Core Web Vitals (LCP 5.4s, CLS 0.35) resulting in lost Google Discover & Google News organic traffic.
solution: Eliminated render-blocking JS/CSS, optimized font loading strategy, implemented custom lazy-load & WebP image pipelines.
result: Passed all Core Web Vitals with 100% green metrics; organic traffic jumped +180% in 60 days.
